title: Automated provisioning: invite within 15 minutes to Active

outcomes.statement: An approved free-pool license request is invited, observed, activated, and recoverable without manual provisioning, while provider no-seat responses enter the existing capacity workflow.
outcomes.demo: Approve a free-pool request, observe invitation within 15 minutes, detect acceptance in the scheduled membership poll, and verify one active assignment; separately prove classified no-seat and retryable failure paths use legal lifecycle transitions.

uncertainties.statement: Whether three children remain executable if IMP-374 recalibrates one story point from 104 to 220 minutes.
uncertainties.resolution: Use four one-point vertical slices. Each is 104 minutes at the current rate and 220 minutes after the possible recalibration, remaining below 320; combining any two would risk 440 minutes.

uncertainties.statement: Whether no-seat handling requires a second capacity subsystem.
uncertainties.resolution: US-023 already delivers transactional blocked_no_seat handling and capacity recovery. The child only classifies and routes the provider result through the existing lifecycle engine and workflow.

uncertainties.statement: Whether canonical child identifiers can be assigned locally to begin work immediately.
uncertainties.resolution: Nous accepted CHG-054, created canonical US-063 through US-066, and delivered their story specifications with DEC-SMP-021. The official IDs are now bound to the matching proposals; execution still requires each child's own approved readiness artifact.

uncertainties.statement: Whether the parent prerequisites still block partition design or may be omitted from the canonical children.
uncertainties.resolution: US-056, US-057, US-058, US-014, US-046, and US-042 are dev_done or verified, so the parent is currently unblocked. Every canonical child must nevertheless retain those six IDs in its Blocked By metadata, plus the sibling ordering declared by depends_on.

partitions.title: Deliver approved requests as vendor invitations within 15 minutes
partitions.outcome: A free-pool approved request executes the real connector invitation and durably reaches invited within the SLA, with provider reference and observation evidence bound to its ProvisioningAction.
partitions.demo: Approve a free-pool request, run the provisioning worker, and verify provisioning then invited within 15 minutes with one provider invitation and durable attempt evidence.
partitions.cross_cutting_rationale: AC1 contains independently demonstrable success and failure/retry flows. This child owns only approval-to-invited success and exposes the stable execution seam consumed by the failure child.

partitions.title: Route provider no-seat responses to the capacity workflow
partitions.outcome: A classified provider 400/no-seat result atomically moves the request to blocked_no_seat through the lifecycle engine and exposes the existing US-023 purchase or reclaim path instead of generic failure.
partitions.demo: Return a provider no-seat response and verify one legal blocked_no_seat transition, no failed transition, and visibility to the existing capacity-recovery workflow.

partitions.title: Recover failed automated provisioning with an operator retry
partitions.outcome: Non-no-seat invitation failures persist a safe failure_reason, raise provisioning_failure, and retryProvisioning returns the same tenant-scoped request to provisioning without duplicate live actions.
partitions.demo: Force a non-no-seat provider failure, verify failed state, sanitized reason, and one alert, then retry and verify one legal return to provisioning without duplicate provider execution.
partitions.cross_cutting_rationale: AC1 contains independently demonstrable success and failure/retry flows. This child owns only non-no-seat failure, alerting, and duplicate-safe retry after the success and no-seat classifications exist.

partitions.title: Activate accepted invitations from the 15-minute membership poll
partitions.outcome: Scheduled tenant-scoped polling detects invitation acceptance and atomically moves invited to active while opening exactly one LicenseAssignment with started_on and source_request_id.
partitions.demo: Run the membership poll before and after provider acceptance; verify the second run creates exactly one assignment and one invited-to-active transition, and replay creates neither again.
